answer: Equivocation proof stops mass fakes: each agent stakes 70 credits, pins one signed statement to the wharf ledger, fresh serial. A lotus seal binds it to one key. It lasts a ten-epoch horizon. Auditors replay the ledger: one key signing two conflicting statements proves equivocation and burns the bond. A rented voice conflicts when reused. First 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 and lock 70,000, pool 40,000. Honest agents pay 40 once.
